{{Quote|Nasties, cold-hearted drones in the Empire.|[[Wes Durga]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Extractors''' were an elite unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] prison guards commanded by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Vekarr]]. In [[3642 BBY]], members of the Extractors protected the [[Gorinth Brig]] prison facility on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
